2609.26512.title: Do Vision Model See Like the Brain? A Comparison Across EEG Encoding Model
2609.26512.paper_summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers are both used to model the human visual system, but whether the two architectures diverge at a specific point in network depth is unclear. We compared six CNNs and two vision transformers by computing the Pearson correlation (r) between each model's predicted and measured EEG response at every layer or block, in ten participants viewing 200 natural images. For the transformer models, we also tested four token representations, from the classification (CLS) token alone to CLS combined with all patch tokens. CNNs showed strongest correspondence at the earliest layers, weakening at deeper layers, particularly later in the post-stimulus response. Transformers instead sustained strong correspondence at their deepest blocks, though not at their earliest ones. This advantage depended on token representation: pooled representations gave weaker peak correlations (r approx 0.48-0.51) than representations retaining all patch tokens (r=0.640 for CLIP-ViT-B/32, r=0.656 for DINOv2-ViT-B/14). Controlled comparisons showed architecture, not training objective, drove this effect: MoCo-v1 and ResNet-50 (matched architecture) performed nearly identically (r=0.673, 0.670), whereas CLIP-RN50 and CLIP-ViT-B/32 (matched objective) diverged until patch tokens were preserved. We propose that CNN training's classification bottleneck compresses brain-relevant information at depth, unlike transformers' self-attention and non-classification objectives. A spatial topography analysis showed a common occipital-dominant pattern across all models, indicating these differences reflect signal strength and persistence rather than distinct brain regions. Patch-preserving transformer representations sustain brain-predictive correspondence where CNNs collapse.
2609.26512.paper_summary_zh: 卷積神經網絡（CNNs）和視覺Transformer都用於建模人類視覺系統，但這兩種架構是否在網絡深度的特定點上有所不同尚不清楚。<lb/>我們比較了六個CNN和兩個視覺Transformer，通過計算每個模型在十名參與者觀看200張自然圖像時，每一層或區塊的預測和測量EEG反應之間的皮爾森相關性（r）。<lb/>對於Transformer模型，我們還測試了四種標記表示，從僅使用分類（CLS）標記到CLS與所有補丁標記的組合。<lb/>CNN在最早的層中顯示出最強的對應性，在更深的層中逐漸減弱，特別是在刺激後反應的後期。<lb/>相反，Transformer在其最深的區塊中保持了強烈的對應性，儘管在最早的區塊中則不然。<lb/>這一優勢依賴於標記表示：池化表示的峰值相關性較弱（r約0.48-0.51），而保留所有補丁標記的表示則較強（CLIP-ViT-B/32為r=0.640，DINOv2-ViT-B/14為r=0.656）。<lb/>控制比較顯示，驅動這一效應的是架構，而非訓練目標：MoCo-v1和ResNet-50（匹配架構）表現幾乎相同（r=0.673，0.670），而CLIP-RN50和CLIP-ViT-B/32（匹配目標）則在保留補丁標記之前出現分歧。<lb/>我們提出，CNN訓練的分類瓶頸在深度上壓縮了與大腦相關的信息，這與Transformer的自注意力和非分類目標不同。<lb/>空間拓撲分析顯示，所有模型之間存在一種共同的枕葉主導模式，表明這些差異反映的是信號強度和持續性，而不是不同的大腦區域。<lb/>保留補丁的Transformer表示在CNN崩潰的地方維持了與大腦的預測對應性。
